name: LiquidStack
description: Liquid-cooling systems vendor in Carrollton, Texas, selling coolant distribution units and high-density cooling for AI workloads. Trane Technologies completed its acquisition in March 2026.
notes: The homepage presents a CDU-centric portfolio and does not mention immersion, while Trane's release describes 'liquid, direct-to-chip, and immersion cooling' - the immersion capability is the parent's wording, not the vendor page's.

sources.note: CDU product lines, Carrollton TX, read 2026-11-16
